source: EnerMap calibration protocol (this tool): Py-BOBYQA on seven physics parameters against DESNZ LSOA gas and electricity means (meter-weighted squared relative error, gas + electricity), dated population; post-processing fixed from evidence

warm_start.note: start point of the search (an earlier exploratory fit); the optimum is defined by the objective, not the start

fixed_post_processing_sources.boiler_eff: EST 2009 in-situ trial weighted by the EHS 2021 boiler mix
fixed_post_processing_sources.hp_scop: Electrification of Heat demonstration median seasonal performance (space heating)
fixed_post_processing_sources.dhw_scale: hot-water volumes as measured (46 + 26 N litres/day)

objective.weights: gas and electricity meter counts per LSOA

spatial_cv.note: each held-out band scored by the best of eight candidate parameter sets chosen on the other bands; simulations shared across folds

representatives.note: three stratified household draws per representative (Latin hypercube over heating-regime share and thermostat quantiles); their mean is the archetype's expected demand
